tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files by name on the local disk of this computer. Matches file names only, not their contents. Use this for finding a local file by its name. For finding text inside local files, use `find_files`. For finding a file in the cloud drive, use `locate_files`. For listing recently modified local files, use `query_files`.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find text inside files on the local disk. Returns each file and line where the phrase appears; does not match file names. Use this for finding text inside local files. For finding a local file by its name, use `search_files`. For finding a file in the cloud drive, use `locate_files`. For listing recently modified local files, use `query_files`.

tools.name: locate_files
tools.description: Locate files by name in the user's cloud drive (synced online storage). Does not look at the local disk. Use this for finding a file in the cloud drive. For finding a local file by its name, use `search_files`. For finding text inside local files, use `find_files`. For listing recently modified local files, use `query_files`.

tools.name: query_files
tools.description: List files on the local disk that were modified within the last N days, newest first. Use this for listing recently modified local files. For finding a local file by its name, use `search_files`. For finding text inside local files, use `find_files`. For finding a file in the cloud drive, use `locate_files`.
